platform: CJSW 90.9 FM Official Digital Music Submission Form
manual_review_reason: CJSW accepts digital EPs and albums only: at least three unique tracks, released within the previous three months, no singles, MP3 files only and the complete release supplied as a ZIP. The official Jotform requests contact and release metadata, genre, location, biography, RIYL, a streaming or website URL, the ZIP release, optional one-sheet, artwork and permission to share the release with programmers and permanently add it to the station's digital library. The form exposes a leave-empty anti-spam field. A human must select an eligible MarcsMusic release, verify the release window, rights, metadata and permission scope, inspect the live form for any runtime CAPTCHA or changed requirements, upload the approved files, leave the anti-spam field untouched and submit manually.

platform: CFUV 101.9 FM Official Digital Music Submission Email
manual_review_reason: CFUV directs all digital music submissions to music@cfuv.ca and requires at least three unique tracks, 320 kbps MP3 files delivered through a download link, and complete artist, album and track-listing information. A one-page biography is recommended. A human must choose a suitable MarcsMusic release, verify ownership, release status, recording quality, non-commercial editorial fit and complete track metadata, prepare an approved download route, reconfirm the mailbox and send the email manually. Physical submissions are normally limited to local Victoria-area artists and are not part of the queued global digital route.
